_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Equipment Facility Requirements (EFR) Plan
summary: The Equipment Facility Requirements (EFR) Plan identifies the training equipment shore facility requirements and coordinates the training responsibilities transition from the Training Support Agent (TSA) to the Training Agent.
use_relationship:
The Equipment Facility Requirements (EFR) Plan identifies the training equipment shore facility requirements and coordinates the training responsibilities transition from the Training Support Agent (TSA) to the Training Agent.  An EFR Plan is applicable to all situations where procurement of Technical Training Equipment (TTE) / Training Devices (TD) and logistic support is required to establish or sustain formal training at Naval training activities.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to all acquisition programs where the procurement of Technical Training Equipment (TTE) / Training Devices (TD) and logistics support is required.

This plan is the principal document stating equipment facility requirements and all logistic support elements necessary to support the establishment of a training program at a Naval training activity.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The EFR shall be presented in the contractor's format as follows:

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain the following sections:

children.title: Section I - Facility Requirements and Identification (Preliminary Site Survey)
Date Preliminary Site Survey conducted
children.content: shall be identified as day/month/year.

children.title: Navy Training System Plan (NTSP)
children.content: shall reference the Training Device Requirements Document (TDRD) or establishing authority.  Cite NTSP number, date and status (draft, proposed) if no NTSP, cite TDRD or other documentation which establishes the requirement.

children.title: Operational Use Summary (Unclassified)
children.content: Describe the operational use of the equipment as it applies to total force use.  Identify ship classes on which equipment is installed.

children.title: Training Concept Summary
children.content: The scope of training to be established, sustained, or revised as a result of the installation, i.e., Intermediate / Organizational level maintenance and Operator Training as well as the course titles and identification numbers (CIN) shall be identified.

children.title: Functional Description
children.content: A brief functional description of the training equipment.

children.title: A listing of Training Equipment to be installed
children.content: A listing of Training Equipment to be installed, Technical Training Equipment and/or Training Devices to be provided, quantity, procuring activity(s) and delivery status shall be included.

children.title: Interface / Impacts on Other Training Equipment
children.content: Describe the interfaces / impacts on other training equipment, including computers, which are presently installed or planned for installation.  Instances of multiple phased installations, which are covered by other individual EFR Plans, shall be considered.  Where applicable, other EFR plans shall be referenced.

children.title: Training Equipment to be Replaced
children.content: All training equipment that will be replaced and / or relocated as a result of this installation shall be identified.

children.title: Training Activity (Command / Location)
children.content: The training activity's address as listed in the current Standard Naval Distribution List (SNDL), zip code and Unit Identification Code (UIC) shall be identified.

children.title: Points of Contact
children.content: The Point of contact shall specify:

children.title: Command, Code, Name, Title, Telephone DSN/Com
OPNAV Sponsor, CNO Program Sponsor and/or Mission Sponsor
Training Support Agent (TSA), Program Manager, ILS Manager, EFR Manager
Training Agent (TA)
children.content: List point of contact and Functional Commander, shall be identified.

children.title: Training Activity Facility Manager and point of contact
children.content: Training Activity Facility Manager and point of contact within the academic department shall also be identified.

children.title: Installation Activity Project Engineer and/or Manager
children.content: Installation Activity Project Engineer and/or Manager shall be identified.

children.title: Training Support Agent Installation Project Number
children.content: Identify the number used by the TSA to track and identify the Installation project.

children.title: Training Equipment Location at Training Activity
children.content: Include Building Number and Room Number.

children.title: Basic Facility Requirements of Training Equipment
Water flow rate, temperature, and purity
Description of Military Construction (MILCON) / Special Project Requirements
children.content: including MILCON or Special Project number and relative data.

children.title: Training Program Ready-For-Training (RFT) date
children.content: the CNO established RFT date as set forth in the current Navy Training System Plan or other reference.

children.title: Beneficial Occupancy Date (BOD)
children.content: shall identify the date facility will be ready to receive the equipment in order to begin the installation.

children.title: Phase I Data Scheduled Updates
children.content: include the (month/year) for MILCON programming and/or Special Project programming.

children.title: Phase II Engineering Site Survey scheduled date
children.content: Phase II Engineering Site Survey scheduled date (month/year).

children.title: Section III - Installation and Transfer Requirements; Engineering Site Survey and Training Support Package
Date Engineering Site Survey conducted
children.content: (day/month/year).

children.title: Identify training course name, Title Course Identification Number
children.content: Identify training course name, Title Course Identification Number (CIN), and length.

children.title: Planned date of transfer of responsibility
children.content: Planned date of transfer of responsibility for the training program from the TSA to the TA.

children.title: List of Equipment
children.content: List of Technical Training Equipment (TTE).  State the precise nomenclature of the TTE, quantity to be provided, procuring activity, delivery status, and tracking numbers.

children.title: List of Training Devices (TD)
children.content: State the precise nomenclature of the TD, quantity to be provided, procuring activity, delivery status, and tracking numbers for training devices.

children.title: List of Trainer Unique Equipment (TEU)
children.content: List all Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) to be provided and vendor items to be procured as part of a training device or in support of operational TTE and identify the precise nomenclature of the TEU, quantity to be provided, procuring activity, delivery status, and tracking numbers.

children.title: System Interface with Other Installed/Future Systems or Equipment
children.content: This shall include updates to the information already provided.

children.title: List Major Milestones and Identify the following
Training Command
children.content: Training Activity short title and location.

children.title: Define the EFR Schedule by date
Identify security Classification of Equipment, courses
children.content: Identify security Classification of Equipment, courses, include any ADP security requirements

children.title: Environmental Safety; Federal, State, and Local
Electromagnetic Radiation Safety
children.content: Include RF hazards to personnel, fuel and ammunition

children.title: Fire Extinguish Requirements
children.content: Type of agent(s) recommended and special precautions to be observed.

children.title: Air Conditioning and Heating requirements which shall include
children.content: Air Conditioning and Heating requirements which shall include temperature parameters of the equipment and Heating requirements

children.title: Air conditioning/cooling requirements
children.content: which shall identify room and equipment

children.title: Ventilation requirement which shall include room
children.content: Ventilation requirement which shall include room and equipment

children.title: Humidity Factors
children.content: which shall include room and equipment

children.title: Define Plumbing requirements which shall identify the following
Water requirements; flow rate temperature, and purity
Sewage requirements; type, volume/capacity, and pollution abatement
Define Electrical Power requirements, which shall also include the following
Electrical Power requirements, emergency shut-down requirements
Grounding requirements, such as; AC, DC, Digital, and RF
Requirement for Generators, Transformers, and converters
Hydraulic, Compressed Gas, Steam, Petroleum, Oil
children.content: Hydraulic, Compressed Gas, Steam, Petroleum, Oil and Liquids (POL) and other fluid requirements.

children.title: Space; minimum physical cube requirements into
children.content: Space; minimum physical cube requirements into which the requirement will fit and space for foreseeable growth requirements

children.title: Floor loading, false flooring, false overhead
children.content: Floor loading, false flooring, false overhead and cable runs/waveguide requirements

children.title: Security/safety limitation requirements
children.content: Also, include classified data in computer memory

children.title: Include any other special consideration not previously
children.content: Include any other special consideration not previously covered

children.title: Site Selection
children.content: shall identify Military Construction (MILCON) / Special Project requirements including building number, room number, site and room modification requirements, equipment room/storage area requirements.

children.title: Trainer Configuration Depiction
children.content: A preliminary isometric arrangement of the training equipment, given the classroom / laboratory space available.

children.title: Estimated completion date for installation design plans
children.content: Estimated completion date for installation design plans provided during Phase II to show the planned training equipment installation with all interfaces and any required modifications to the classroom / laboratory.

children.title: As-built/installed equipment drawings
children.content: submitted to the Training Agent and training activity within 60 days following installation, checkout and final acceptance.  Final equipment installation drawings include the following:

children.title: A&E prints that apply to the installation
children.content: A&E prints that apply to the installation (assembly drawings, elevation drawings, cable and wiring diagrams.)

children.title: Bill of material for training equipment
Training Support Package
children.content: shall include:

children.title: Support Equipment
children.content: List all support equipment such as cooling towers, overhead hoists, etc., which allows for training equipment operation or otherwise supports the course of instruction but is not part of the curriculum.  Distinguish between GFE and contractor provided equipment and identify the following:

children.title: Technical Data Support Package
children.content: Identify all technical manuals, PMS documentation, MRC, etc. that is to be provided and include the following:

children.title: Curriculum Material
children.content: List all curriculum to be provided to the Training Agent, including NTSP identified course materials and any contractor developed materials to support training devices.  The identification of curriculum deliverables should include items such as Instructor Guides, Trainee Materials, TASA, and Handbooks shall also be included.  Identify the curriculum military standard used if applicable.  List all Data Item Descriptions (DIDs) used.  List all Training Aids to be provided such as films, transparencies, training tapes, mock-ups, pre-faulted modules, fault insertion aids and unique audio-visual equipment including:

children.title: Equipment Check-out and Test Procedures Report
Initial Instructor and Support Personnel Training Requirements
children.content: Describe all initial (factory) training required prior to the RFT date.  Use subheadings as required to show the various types of initial training to be provided.  Include required training for assigned instructor personnel and for follow-on maintenance support for training devices.

children.title: Installation Funding Requirements
children.content: site Preparation (Installation only required), special project and MILCON

children.title: On-Site equipment light-off, checkout and Test Procedures
children.content: Describe the manner in which the above actions will be performed in order to demonstrate to the Training Agent that the installation has been accomplished to meet the training requirements.  Reference the Acceptance Test Plan (ATP) which should be developed prior to final acceptance and which shall be included as an annex in the EFR plan.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements
preparation_instructions.content: The EFR plan shall be presented in hard copy on 81/2 inch bond paper or electronic media specified in the contract on the CDRL DD Form 1423.
